  • Zero Manual Scooping: Automatically cleans and safely stores waste for up to 14 days per cat, saving you hours of chores each month.
  • 5 Layer Odor Neutralization: Advanced air circulation and multi-stage filtration lock in smells instantly. It is the perfect solution for apartments and open-concept living spaces.
  • Open Top Comfort: A spacious, unconfined design that feels natural and safe. It easily accommodates large breeds like Maine Coons, providing them with the freedom they deserve.
  • Ultimate Safety System: Equipped with 5 infrared and 4 weight sensors that immediately pause the cleaning cycle the exact moment your cat approaches.
  • Smart App Management: Track your cat's daily usage, monitor health trends, and schedule cleanings directly from your iOS or Android device.
  • Effortless Pull and Wrap Disposal: Seal the custom waste bag with one quick pull. Keep your hands 100 percent clean and toss the bag straight into the trash without a second thought.

Dimensions and Compatibility

  • Product Dimensions: 22.83" W x 19.69" D x 26.83" H. Spacious open top design for cats from 2.2 lbs to 33 lbs.
  • Compatible Litter: Works best with fast clumping mineral or bentonite clay (particles up to 3mm diameter and 10mm length).
  • Litter to Avoid: Do not use non-clumping, highly absorbent, newspaper, or large wood pellets to prevent machine jams.
